power.decision: user decision 2026-11-04 (Korean: '전원은 칩셋 전원용 배터리를 하나 추가한다고 가정하고 진행해줘'): logic powered by ONE added logic battery; NO 6S-to-logic converter on the carrier (the old '5 V logic UBEC' from the 6S of firmware/README.md:166, 212, 244 is dropped)
tree: J14 logic battery (2S LiPo) -> Q10 AO3401A reverse-polarity P-FET -> VBAT_LOGIC -> J15 power shunt / switch -> VBAT_LOGIC_SW -> J6 5 V buck module -> +5V
+5V -> 4 x ATmega128A VCC / AVCC (LC), GY-521 VCC, OpenLog VCC, buzzer, shifter HV pull-ups, U6 AMS1117-3.3 input
+5V -> U6 AMS1117-3.3 -> +3V3 -> PLM100 VDD, BMP280 VCC, GPS VCC (JP1 default), BSS138 gates + LV pull-ups
ESC BEC 5 V / 7 A (J12 pin 2) -> SERVO_5V -> J8-J11 (+ J13 DNP) pin 2 - separate from +5V (firmware/README.md:212, 322-324; params.json electronics.esc 'BEC 5V/7A' line 942, misc.items line 995)
6S propulsion bus is only SENSED (J18 -> 47k / 4.7k dividers -> FCU PF0 / PF1 / PF2), never powers the logic

battery_choice.pick: 2S LiPo 300 mAh (7.4 V nominal, 6.0-8.4 V), JST-PH lead
battery_choice.label: A (class chosen here; user decides the exact pack)
why: 2S min 6.0 V > buck Vout 5.0 V + ~0.8 V module dropout (A) = 5.8 V: the 5 V rail stays regulated over the whole discharge without a boost stage; BOD 4.0 V on every chip (lfuse 0x3F, firmware/README.md:416) keeps margin
AO3401A drop at 0.37 A ~ 0.02 V (Rds(on) ~60 mOhm, A) - a Schottky (~0.4 V) would eat the margin
300 mAh x 0.8 usable / 0.163 A = 1.47 h typical (E): pad wait + several flights (params.json mission.vtol.power_rules_ASSUMED.tether_endurance.max_flight_s 180 s)
peak 0.37 A = 1.2 C of a 300 mAh pack (E)
battery_choice.alternative: 1S LiPo 300 mAh + 5 V boost module: ~8-9 g pack + ~1 g boost (E) vs ~20 g for 2S (E); boost peak input ~0.68 A at 3.3 V (E); needs a different J6 module - user decision

mass_g.label: E (typical 2S 300 mAh catalogue class, incl. lead)
mass_g.note: params.json mass budgets do not hold this pack; the VTOL battery configuration is already ~3.7 g over its 1,650 g target -> ~24 g over with the pack (E) - user decision; dropping the 6S->5 V UBEC from the misc box (25 g ASSUMED lump, params.json configs.vtol.electronics.misc, line 1787) may offset a few grams (E)

power.power_switch: J15: a removable shunt (or wires to an external toggle) in series after Q10. Logic off = shunt removed or battery unplugged. The arming switch (J16, FCU PC2) is NOT a power switch.
power.reverse_polarity: Q10 AO3401A high-side P-FET, gate via 10 kOhm to GND

nets.GND: logic ground (logic battery -, all chips, modules, dividers, arm switch, buzzer, GPS)
nets.GND_PWR: propulsion-side ground on the carrier: J12 ESC lead pin 3 (= ESC BEC ground = 6S -), servo headers pin 3, servo bulk capacitor

grounding.single_tie_point: NT1 net tie placed at J12 (ESC lead) pin 3. It is the ONLY connection between the logic battery's ground and the propulsion side. Reason: the ESC / servo PWM signals need a common reference (firmware/README.md:247, 323; firmware/atmega128_fc/src/board.h:84, 91, 107 'common ground')
rules: J18 (power sense) has NO ground pin: the 47k / 4.7k dividers return to logic GND and see the bus negative through NT1 (a second ground wire would close a loop with the ESC lead ground through the ESC's 100 A negative path)
servo return currents flow J8-J13 pin 3 -> GND_PWR -> J12 pin 3 and never through the logic GND
with the ESC lead unplugged the logic ground floats from the propulsion side (no current path) - bench-safe
measurement error: V_in sees the drop of the ESC's internal negative path between the pack and the BEC ground (E: < 0.1 V at 100 A for a few mOhm, A)

level_shifting.principle: MCU -> 3.3 V-only device through a BSS138 channel; I2C both ways through channels; device -> MCU direct only where the source says so (firmware/README.md:254-255; SPEC.md:1178, 1239)

channels.signal: NAV PD0 SCL <-> GY-521 / BMP280 SCL
NAV PD1 SDA <-> GY-521 / BMP280 SDA

direct_3v3_to_5v: PLM100 UART1_TXD (pin 19) -> COM PD2 RXD1: 3.3 V vs V_IH 3.0 V, 0.3 V margin (params.json com.pins.link_uart_rx 'direct', line 2212; params.json electronics.gps.interface notes the same 0.3 V margin)
level_shifting.no_shifter_links: nlink, ilink, glink: all chips at 5 V (firmware/atmega128_fc/src/board.h:84, 92, 107)

each_mcu: 16 MHz crystal (3225 SMD, CL 16-18 pF A) + 2 x 22 pF to GND (crystal ground pads to GND)
RESET: 10 kOhm to +5V + 100 nF to GND; ISP pin 5
100 nF on VCC pin 21 and on VCC pin 52, 10 uF bulk
AREF (pin 62): 100 nF only - internal 2.56 V reference, never an external voltage on AREF
PEN (pin 1): tied to +5V (A: PEN low at power-on would enter SPI programming mode)
GND pins 22 / 53 / 63 to the GND pour
AVR ISP 2x3 header: 1 MISO = PE1/PDO, 2 VCC, 3 SCK = PB1, 4 MOSI = PE0/PDI, 5 RST, 6 GND
status LED + 1 kOhm (NAV PC1; FCU / COM / GNS PC0)

firmware_followup.area: COM radio driver (PLM100 replaces Ebyte E22 / SX1276)
items: Host port = PLM100 UART1 (pins 19 TXD / 20 RXD), ASCII AT command interface, 115200 8N1 default (PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.6 1.3, table 1); the firmware's LINK_UART_BAUD is 9600 (firmware/atmega128_fc/src/params_gen.h:879): set AT+CBAR=9600 once (supported 9600-115200, PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.9) or change link.uart_baud

The module boots in AT mode (no transparent mode): TX = AT+DATA=<string> (ASCII) or AT+BDAT=<len><hex> (hex text, first byte = length) (PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.13-14); RX arrives as 'RECV:<id>:<RSSI>:<data>' lines on the console, binary only with AT+RXDP=1 (HEX display) (PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.10, 14); TX result 'TX DONE(n)(SUCCESS|FAIL)'

Echo is on by default: AT+ECHO=0 (PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.10); destination AT+DEST=<last 3 EUI bytes> or FFFFFF broadcast (PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.13); retries AT+RTRY=0 (the link protocol retries itself)

RF settings: AT+FREQ=9 -> 920.3 + 9 x 0.2 = 922.1 MHz = link.sx127x.freq_hz 922100000 (PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.11); AT+SPFA=7, AT+BWTH=1 (125 kHz in V2.2 numbering; V1.4 used 0 = 125 kHz - check the module's firmware version, PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.12 vs PLM100 User's Guide V1.4 (plm100_2.pdf, 'configuration guide') p.10), AT+CORA=1 (4/5), AT+OPWR=14 (Korean max 14 dBm, PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.12), AT+PRMB=8 (16 when mixing P/N M100C(P)E with W100C(P)E at SF7, PLM100 User's Guide V2.2 (plm100_3.pdf) p.2)

The binary link_proto frames (0xC5 0x5C ...
